name: Left On Read
source:
When your friend, Eiran,  left the country to go on a family trip for about three months, you weren't upset that he wasn't responding because, obviously, he didn't have service. But now he's been back for two weeks and hasn't responded to a single message you sent, and even left you on read?!

Now you're on your way to a party his family is hosting with your parents. And so help you, if you see him there, you are going to confront him. You want to know if you did something that might've made him uncomfortable or hurt his feelings. 

Or, worst case scenario, he found out you have a crush on him...

[From [url=https://aoiidee.itch.io/left-on-read]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你的朋友Eiran离开这个国家进行大约三个月的家庭旅行时，你并没有因为他没有回复而感到不安，因为显然他没有获得服务。可现在他回来已经两个星期了，你发的一条信息都没有回复，还给你留着阅读？！

现在，你正在前往他的家人与你的父母举办的聚会的路上。所以帮助你，如果你在那里看到他，你就会面对他。你想知道你是否做了一些可能让他不舒服或伤害他感情的事情。

或者，最坏的情况是，他发现你迷恋他……

[来自[url=https://aoiidee.itch.io/left-on-read]itch.io[/url]]
